Every authoritative and derived artifact is regenerated on the 0.25 candidate SHA and frozen, as 0.24 C2 did (0.24 contract section 8, condition 6).
The 0.24 G2 determinism protocol runs on the 0.25 candidate SHA under its registered pins and failure rule.
The 0.24 R2 release gate (adjudication-gated publish) passes for the 0.25 candidate's own identity, and every release surface consumes that one identity (0.24 contract section 8, condition 7).
